display.purpose: The home hero line only (36px; 31px under 936px).

headline.purpose: Base h1 (29px); session title 23px, brand name 23px uppercase at 0.04em.

title.purpose: h2 22px and h3 18px in content; guide-step and empty-state titles at 600/18px; modal head 600/21px.

body.purpose: The 17px/1.5 base; tables and timeline cards 16px; hints 11-16px.

label.purpose: Uppercase, Ink 2: panel and pane heads, section titles, customizer group titles, popover titles.

label-small.purpose: Uppercase, Ink 3: table heads and card heads; .label at 0.08em, dt at 0.04em. Field labels are 16px 600 0.04em, not uppercase.

button.purpose: The .btn family, mixed case; 16px small, 14px extra-small, 18px large. Tabs and segmented switches go uppercase at 16px.

mono.purpose: Tabular figures for measured, computed and target values, parameter names, chips and readouts; 15px summary lines, 14px HUD and dim labels, 13px counts.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Panels, panes, the top bar and the mobile pane switch; reads flat. Dark: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25).

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Toasts, popovers and the settings modal — the only visible lift. Dark: 0 16px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3).

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Buttons, inputs, thumb and switch on :focus-visible, with the border turned Action Blue; tabs and segments take it inset at 3px. Dark: rgba(108,158,240,.3).

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: The global :focus-visible outline for everything without its own halo.

shadows.name: current-ring
shadows.purpose: The guide's current step and a focused number box, on a blue border.

shadows.name: thumb
shadows.purpose: The slider thumb; the switch knob uses 0 1px 3px at the same alpha.

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: The one easing curve: every state transition and entrance.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Background, border, colour and shadow on buttons, rows, drops and the switch.

motion.name: duration-pop
motion.purpose: Popover pop-in (fade, translateY(-5px)); toast and modal rise-in (fade, translateY(8px)).

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: dim-in: dimension labels settle onto a freshly measured mesh — the one authored moment.

motion.name: thumb-scale
motion.purpose: The slider thumb on hover and drag.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: A running pill's dot and a running graph node's stroke.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The 18px spinner (3px rule, Action Blue cap).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Header compacts, brand tag and path hide, icon buttons drop their text, hero drops to 31px.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Workspace collapses to one pane with a bottom switch; home goes single-column; top bar and centre head wrap.

components.name: Dimension Line
components.description: The brand motif: one 1 px Dimension Blue rule with 1 x 14 px ticks and numbered stations in mono blue — how the home page says how it works, in place of a card grid.

1. 1Photograph the broken part on the printed calibration sheet
  2. 2Answer the one or two photos it still needs
  3. 3Verify every dimension measured on the designed mesh
  4. 4Print the fit coupon, then the part

narrative.overview:
Kintsugi's interface is an engineering drawing's sheet: fine grid paper under everything, white panels ruled with 1 px navy-tinted lines, title-block labels in tracked condensed capitals, dimension lines with ticks, and measured values set in tabular mono. One blue does every job that asks for a decision — the primary button, the link, the active tab, the caret, the focus ring — and two lighter blues serve it as tints: Dimension Blue for lines and ghosts, Tolerance Tint for selection and the band a measurement is allowed to live in. Nothing else in the palette speaks except the three status colours, and those never speak alone.

The voice is precise, calm and evidential. Density is earned by the task: the home page is spacious (one hero line, one dimension-line strip, two panels); the session workspace is dense (three panes, 17 px body, 16 px tables, 14 px column labels) because a maker reviewing checks wants every dimension on screen at once. Decoration is refused; expression lives in details a drafter would recognise — the ticks on the path, the pale bracket above a slider, the arrow before a target value. The system refuses the SaaS-dashboard arrangement of hero-metric cards: a status is a 9 px dot before a heading, a number is a measured value with its evidence, never a big tile.

Light is the default (a bench in daylight); dark is composed from the navy rather than inverted and follows the system setting. Type is self-hosted so the sheet renders with no CDN reachable.
keyCharacteristics: Grid paper ground: a 31 px minor / 156 px major blueprint grid on the body, under every pane; panels never redraw it.
Navy-tinted everything: inks, rules, shadows and the scrim all descend from #05142E — no neutral gray anywhere.
One action blue (#155DD3), two servant tints (#6C9EF0, #BED4F9), three status colours that always carry a word or an icon.
Two typefaces plus a mono: Barlow Semi Condensed for headings and tracked title-block labels, IBM Plex Sans body at 17 px, IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures for every measured value.
Flat by default: 1 px rules and a whisper-faint rest shadow on panels; soft offset shadows only lift overlays.
Crisp and measured forms: 3 / 4 / 8 px radii, pills only for status, one 24-unit stroke icon family.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Only #155DD3 asks for action. The two lighter blues are tints — they outline, band, ghost and highlight — and never fill a button or underline a link on their own.

rules.name: The Never-Gray Rule
rules.body: Every ink, rule, scrim and shadow is mixed from the navy. A neutral gray (`#888`, `#ccc`, `gray-500`) has no place on the sheet.

rules.name: The Word-With-Colour Rule
rules.body: Pass, fail and warn always travel with text or an icon — a pill's label, a check mark, a 9 px marker beside a heading. Colour alone never states a measurement's status.

rules.name: The Title-Block Rule
rules.body: A block of the sheet is named in tracked condensed capitals (16 px, 700, 0.08em) on a 1 px rule — never in sentence-case bold, never larger than 16 px.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Any number that was measured, computed or targeted is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures, right-aligned in tables, with its unit or target beside it (`→ 43.2`). Prose numbers stay in the body face.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Only what floats above the sheet (toast, popover, modal) casts a visible shadow. A panel, card or table row gets a rule and, at most, the rest shadow — never the pop shadow, never a hover lift.

dos: Do keep the blueprint grid on the body only (31 px minor / 156 px major, Action Blue at 5 % / 7.5 %) and place every pane on it as a white rectangle with a 1 px Rule.
Do name each block of the sheet with a title-block label — Barlow 700, 16 px, 0.08em, uppercase, Ink 2 — on a Rule 2 line.
Do set every measured, computed or target value in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures, right-aligned in tables, with its unit or `→ target` beside it.
Do use #155DD3 for every action, link, active tab, caret and focus, and soft blue (#E2ECFC) for every hover and active fill; in dark mode let the action colour become #6C9EF0 with navy text.
Do draw controls from the drafting vocabulary: 1 px rules, ticks, tolerance brackets, 9 px status dots, numbered circles.
Do pair pass / fail / warn with a word or an icon, and keep tone borders at 35–60 % of the colour.
Do use the one icon family — 24-unit `viewBox`, `currentColor` stroke, round caps, weight 2 (1.3–1.6 at 39 px and above) — at 11–18 px inside controls.
Do keep the three radii (3 / 4 / 8 px), reserve 999 px for status pills and stage chips, and 50 % for dots, numbers, thumb and knob.
Do self-host type (`@fontsource`, latin subsets) and honour `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-color-scheme`.
donts: Don't introduce a neutral gray for text, rules, scrims or shadows; mix from the navy.
Don't let the tints act: no #6C9EF0 or #BED4F9 button fills, links or underlines in light mode.
Don't lift a panel, card or row with the pop shadow or a hover translate; only toasts, popovers and the modal cast a visible shadow.
Don't mark status with a side stripe, a full-bleed colour fill or a big tinted tile; use the 9 px marker before the head and a pill.
Don't arrange the sheet as hero-metric cards or a dashboard of KPIs; density comes from ruled tables and rows.
Don't use glyph icons, icon fonts, emoji or a second icon set; every icon is a 24-unit stroke SVG from `icons.tsx`.
Don't uppercase body copy or the `.btn` family; capitals belong to title-block labels, column labels, tabs and segmented switches.
Don't load fonts, scripts or images from a CDN; the sheet must render off-grid.
